newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sembawang unit in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Sembawang unit in joint venture.

text.p: Sembawang Business International Pte Ltd (SBI), a unit of shiprepair firm Sembawang Corp, said on Monday it has signed a memorandum of understanding with HCL Technology Pte Ltd to develop manufacturing and production-related projects in the Asia-Pacific region.

The statement quoted Tony Siddique, chief executive officer of SBI, as saying that there was an increasing number of technology companies in Europe and North America which are planning to set up operations in Asia.

HCL is a division of the Hagemeyer-Cosa Liebermann Group. It said SBI was established in April 1996 with the aim of identifying and screening technology-related business opportunities in Asia that would involve Singapore companies.
An HCL official said SBI was involved in developing manufacturing and production related enterprises in marine and engineering fields.

HCL Technology and Hagemeyer-Cosa Liebermann Group are involved in providing marketing services to European and U.S. companies to sell their goods including leisure, fashion and technology products in the Asia-Pacific region.
The SBI statement did not say how much the deal is worth and the HCL official declined comment.
